summary: Shows triggering an included handler file by notifying the include's name, which runs every task in it as handlers.
questions: How do I trigger handlers from include_tasks?

answer_card.title: Triggering included (dynamic) handlers
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
handlers:
  - name: Restart services
    include_tasks: restarts.yml
tasks:
  - command: "true"
    notify: Restart services
```

This runs all tasks in `restarts.yml`.
